label: Feet + gait documented together
significance: Bilateral foot pain and abnormal gait are already one presenting problem.

label: Neurology referral framed as gait + feet + muscle tension
significance: Primary care frames the neurological question around the whole feet–gait–tone problem.

label: Marked bilateral leg tone
significance: Pathological tone joins the pre-existing feet/gait problem before Neurology.

label: Urgent referral transmits the whole problem
significance: The referral begins with the painful abnormal feet/gait problem and then explains why the GP suspects a neurological process; it asks Neurology to explain the presentation as a whole.

label: Neurological component becomes dominant
significance: The record shows extensive development of severe young-onset Parkinsonism/PRKN and comparatively limited direct evaluation of the painful abnormal feet: an observable asymmetry of clinical weighting.

label: Established Protest restores paragraph one
significance: The patient says the feet have not been properly dealt with and the work cannot be complete. He restores the underweighted originating problem; he does not introduce a new one.

label: Podiatry answer after restored referral problem
significance: Initial narrowing may have been understandable, but after the Protest the original foot problem is expressly back in view. No neurological reopening or defined neurological handover question is identified.

label: Discharge synthesis makes the founding join
significance: The synthesis contains the dystonic-looking lower-limb, structural-foot, Parkinsonism and PRKN material and joins them directionally: Parkinsonism/PRKN is extensively developed while painful feet are made compatible with separate/peripheral-neuropathy/'Not clear'/Podiatry territory.

label: Patient-derived separation strengthened; Protest omitted
significance: 'Markedly divorced' and compatible understanding/plan language travel; the patient's warning that the originating problem remained unfinished does not.

label: Procyclidine withdrawal boundary test
significance: Treatment state alters gait, tension and feet together, testing the direction and adequacy of the founding join.

label: Neurology records rapid outside-left-foot return
significance: Neurology now holds dynamic treatment-state evidence about the same foot territory, creating a clear opportunity to reconstruct the founding join.

label: Podiatry accumulates focal mechanical evidence
significance: A recurrent fifth-MTPJ loading problem is repeatedly treated and offloaded mechanically.

label: GP reconnects feet with tone/gait/Parkinson's
significance: Primary care regenerates the integrated formulation rather than accepting the founding partition as exhaustive.

label: Letters described as creating shared understanding
significance: The longitudinal letters are explicitly instruments of communicated interpretation.

label: Pain + shuffling described as OFF-related
significance: Later treatment-state evidence crosses the founding directional boundary.

label: Urgent referral for severe bilateral foot/lower-leg pain
significance: Primary care again links severe pain to the longitudinal Parkinsonian control history.

label: Feet improve when Sinemet acts; CR introduced
significance: The feet are directly documented as changing with dopaminergic treatment state.

label: Historical pathway challenged
significance: The complaint asks why the founding model was not reconstructed earlier in light of later evidence.

label: Historical letters invoked; profound CR relief accepted
significance: Documentary continuity and shared-understanding language are offered as part of the answer to a historical challenge, despite no identified global re-join of the founding 2017 synthesis.
